title: Amortized target-blind probe policy over compact persistent belief sketches
question: Can a learned CDL probe policy approximate the exact one-step budget-aware teacher on held-out hypothesis populations while using a fixed-size belief sketch rather than recomputing all candidate partitions?
hypothesis: A compact amortized policy trained only on training-seed teacher actions will achieve low budget-utility regret on untouched test seeds while reducing per-decision belief-scoring work relative to the exact teacher.

arms.name: greedy_budget_teacher
arms.intervention: exact target-blind maximization of one-step U_B gain per acquisition work over the current candidate belief

arms.name: greedy_information_teacher
arms.intervention: exact target-blind maximization of Shannon information gain per acquisition work

arms.name: amortized_policy
arms.intervention: fixed neural policy over compact per-action belief sketches maintained incrementally

arms.name: fixed_random
arms.intervention: deterministic seeded random action among legal unobserved probes

endpoints.name: normalized_budget_utility_regret_m512_b8
endpoints.role: primary — test-set U_8 regret of amortized_policy relative to exact greedy_budget_teacher at M=512/B=8, normalized by available teacher gain over the no-probe baseline

endpoints.name: verified_success_m512_b8
endpoints.role: secondary — exact verifier success after one selected probe and B=8 shortlist

endpoints.name: teacher_action_agreement_m512
endpoints.role: secondary — exact action agreement with the U_B teacher

endpoints.name: teacher_utility_per_work_regret_m512
endpoints.role: secondary — gap in U_B gain per acquisition work

endpoints.name: policy_inference_work
endpoints.role: secondary — neural forward-pass work and sketch-update work

held_constant: same target-selection distribution on held-out evaluation tasks

teacher_definition.objective: maximize expected U_B gain divided by expected acquisition work
teacher_definition.input: current compatible candidate belief plus unobserved action rows

learned_input_definition.representation: fixed-size per-action first- and second-order statistics of six-bit candidate-predicted trace signatures plus row descriptor, candidate-count term, budget fraction, and acquisition-cost term

terminal_protocol.procedure: Select one probe, reveal realized target evidence, form the exact compatible bucket, retain at most B candidates in fixed public library order, then exact-verify against all 16 truth-table rows.

cost_model.learner: cached candidate-feature encoding plus fixed-size sketch updates plus one neural forward pass over legal actions
cost_model.environment: same activation-trace probe acquisition for teacher and learner

statistical_rule.primary_population: 32 held-out tasks per seed at M=512/B=8
statistical_rule.per_seed_estimate: mean normalized U_B regret across the 32 tasks

leakage_rules: Training labels are generated only on training seeds.
Validation seeds may select the frozen checkpoint; test seeds may not.
The learned policy never receives target identity, target index, realized target evidence, or verifier-only rows before action selection.
The learned policy never receives exact U_B or exact Shannon entropy as an input feature.
Test-seed teacher actions are computed only after the checkpoint and test protocol are frozen.
The external CodeARC evaluation, when added, will have an independent frozen split and will not train this policy.
No exact evaluation structure or truth-table signature may occur in more than one train, validation, or test library across any seeds.

decision_rule.condition: Primary normalized regret CI is near zero and learner uses lower per-decision belief-scoring work than the exact teacher.
decision_rule.licenses: evidence of successful amortization of target-blind one-step probe selection on held-out synthetic populations.
decision_rule.does_not_license: general active-learning superiority or semantic generalization.

decision_rule.condition: Teacher agreement is high but U_B regret is not low.
decision_rule.licenses: agreement is not sufficient; the representation or scoring calibration is failing.

decision_rule.condition: Synthetic test succeeds but external CodeARC evaluation fails.
decision_rule.licenses: the learned policy is generator-specific; do not generalize to real program synthesis.
